source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: 1. I seek protection in Allah from shaytaan the accursed
2. In the name of Allah, the most Compassionate the most Merciful
3. All praise is due to Allah, the Cherisher of the worlds, Most Compassionate Most Merciful,
Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship and You alone
3. Faatiha we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path, the path of those whom You have favoured. Not of those whom You became angered with nor (of those) who went astray. Aameen
4. I seek Allah’s protection that I be from the ignorant ones
5. O Allah, accept from us (our good actions), verily You are all Hearing and all Knowing. Accept our taubah (repentance). Verily You are Most Forgiving,
Most Merciful
6. O Allah, grant us the good of this world and the good of the Hereafter and save us from the punishment of the fire
7. O Allah, infuse sabr (patience) in us, keep our feet firm and help us against the unbelievers

8. We have heard and obeyed. We seek Your forgiveness, O Allah, and to You is our return. O Allah do not punish us for the sins we committed by mistake or in error. Do not burden us with such heavy duties as had been placed on the people before us. O Allah, do not burden us with that which is beyond our ability. Overlook our sins, Forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Master so help us against the disbelievers
9. O Allah! Do not let our hearts go astray after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Your side. Verily You are The Great Giver of favours
O Allah, You will definitely gather all human beings on a Day in which there is no doubt. Verily
Allah never breaks His promise
10. O Allah, we have definitely believed in You, so please forgive our sins and save us from the punishment of the fire
11. (Say) O Allah, Owner of the kingdom, You give authority to whomsoever
You wish and snatch it away from whomsoever You wish. You grant respect to whom

You please and You disgrace whom You wish. All good is in Your hands and surely You have power over all things. You introduce the night into day and the day into night. You take out the living from the dead and the dead from the living and You grant sustenance to whomsoever You wish without any limit
12. O Allah, bless me from Your side with a noble offspring. Verily You hear our duas
13. O Allah, we have believed in what You revealed and we obeyed the messenger so enlist us among the witnesses
14. O Allah, forgive our sins and forgive us for overstepping the mark, keep our feet firm and help us against the disbelievers
15. O Allah, You have not created this (world) without any purpose. You are free from all blemishes so protect us from the fire of Hell. O Allah, whoever You have admitted into Hell, really

You have disgraced him and there are no helpers for the sinners. O Allah, we heard a caller calling us to Imaan saying Believe in your Rabb! so we believed. O Allah, forgive our sins and pardon our wrongs and when removing our souls include us among the righteous. O Allah, grant us what
You have promised us through Your Messengers and do not put us to shame on the Day of Judgement
Surely You never break Your promise
16. O Allah, remove us from this town whose inhabitants practise oppression and make for us from Your side, friends and helpers
17. O Allah, send for us from the heavens a tray of food
